ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SharpWSUS/WSUSpendu Execution
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of SharpWSUS or WSUSpendu, utilities that allow for lateral movement through WSUS.
Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) is a critical component of Windows systems and is frequently configured in a way that allows an attacker to circumvent internal networking limitations.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-Inject\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-PayloadArgs\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-PayloadFile\\ .*"))) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ approve\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ create\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ check\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ delete\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/payload\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/payload\\=.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/updateid\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/updateid\\=.*")))
